<style>
  /* ── Page header ── */
  .pagehead {
    position: relative;
    padding-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + clamp(60px, 9vw, 120px));
    padding-bottom: clamp(50px, 7vw, 96px);
    background: radial-gradient(120% 130% at 60% 0%, var(--field-bg) 0%, var(--surface) 50%, var(--surface) 100%);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .pagehead .wrap { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .pagehead h1 { color: var(--ink); margin: 22px 0 24px; max-width: 18ch; }
  .pagehead .lead { max-width: 52ch; }
  .ph-motif { position: absolute; right: -80px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 460px; height: 460px; z-index: 1; opacity: 0.55; pointer-events: none; }
  .ph-motif circle { fill: none; stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 0.8; }
  .ph-motif .spin { transform-origin: 230px 230px; animation: spin 60s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  /* ── Status legend ── */
  .status-legend {
    display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 22px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  }
  .sl-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); }
  .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .dot-complete { background: var(--success-ink); }
  .dot-testing  { background: var(--accent-fill); }
  .dot-dev      { background: var(--ink-muted); border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted); }

  /* ── Project grid ── */
  .projects-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--line);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .project-card {
    background: var(--surface);
    padding: clamp(32px, 4vw, 52px);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    transition: background 0.4s var(--ease);
  }
  .project-card:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, var(--surface)); }
  .project-card.navy-card { background: var(--surface); }
  .project-card.navy-card:hover { background: var(--field-bg); }

  /* status badge */
  .status-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 2px;
    width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 28px;
    font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600;
  }
  .badge-complete {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-ink) 14%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-ink) 75%, var(--ink));
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-ink) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .badge-testing {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-fill) 14%, transparent); color: var(--accent-ink);
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-fill) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .badge-dev {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 7%, transparent); color: var(--ink-muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .badge-complete .badge-dot { background: var(--success-ink); }
  .badge-testing  .badge-dot { background: var(--accent-fill); animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .badge-dev      .badge-dot { background: var(--ink-muted); }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity:1; } 50% { opacity:0.35; } }

  .project-index {
    font-family: var(--serif); font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 5vw, 4.8rem); color: var(--accent-ink);
    line-height: 0.85; margin-bottom: 20px;
    transition: color 0.6s var(--ease);
  }
  .project-card:hover .project-index,
  .project-card.navy-card .project-index { color: var(--accent-ink); }

  .project-card h2 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.2rem); margin: 0 0 16px; }
  .project-card.navy-card h2 { color: var(--ink); }
  .project-card p { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.65; flex: 1; }
  .project-card.navy-card p { color: var(--ink-muted); }

  .project-footer {
    margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .project-card.navy-card .project-footer { border-top-color: var(--line); }
  .project-tags { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .ptag {
    font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .project-card.navy-card .ptag { color: var(--ink-muted); border-color: var(--line); }

  /* ── Completed: featured card spans full width ── */
  .project-card.featured {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: clamp(30px, 5vw, 64px);
    align-items: start;
    background: var(--surface);
  }
  .project-card.featured:hover { background: var(--field-bg); }
  .project-card.featured .card-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .project-card.featured .card-right { padding-top: 8px; }
  .project-card.featured h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem); color: var(--ink); }
  .project-card.featured p { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .project-card.featured .project-footer { border-top-color: var(--line); }

  .detail-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
  .detail-list li {
    display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start;
    font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--ink-muted);
  }
  .detail-list li::before { content: "→"; color: var(--accent-ink); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }

  @media (max-width: 820px) {
    .projects-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .project-card.featured { grid-column: 1; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
